reference.code: import java.util.*;public final class Solution{public static List<long[]> coalesceRanges(List<long[]>v){var a=new ArrayList<long[]>();for(var r:v){if(r.length!=2||r[0]>=r[1])return null;a.add(r.clone());}a.sort(Comparator.<long[]>comparingLong(r->r[0]).thenComparingLong(r->r[1]));var o=new ArrayList<long[]>();for(var r:a){if(o.isEmpty()||r[0]>o.get(o.size()-1)[1])o.add(r);else o.get(o.size()-1)[1]=Math.max(o.get(o.size()-1)[1],r[1]);}return o;}}
